prompts.exterior:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape game environment concept sheet for redesigning the EXISTING Dragon castle, NOT a different larger castle. Chinese art direction presentation, 2 panels: left 58% width shows whole existing castle from south three-quarter perspective; right 42% shows a human eye-level straight frontal close view of its entrance and threshold. Small elegant headings only: left "外观目标 · 固定深色石材", right "入口 · 平顺通行". Bottom discreet label "概念方案 · 非游戏实机".
References: first image is existing main hall geometry reference, second is existing tower assembly geometry reference; combine these exact building masses at their original relative positions, do not depict separated floating components. Third image is approved existing Western dragon stone statue asset, reuse its recognizable design for the two entrance guardians, no new statue design.
Architecture constraints: compact tall Gothic castle, central rectangular steep-roofed hall and rose window over pointed south door, two unequal-height front square towers (left tower taller with clock), central crossing tower is tallest with long slender spire, lower transverse east/west wings, small rear turrets. Preserve room footprint and tower hierarchy. No expansion, no additional grand wings or domes. Grey-violet charcoal masonry, dark blue slate shingles, very restrained aged brass, muted purple and warm amber window glows. Walls have visible hand-painted stone blocks, proper depth around arches, modest chipped bevels, buttresses and cornices. Stylized semi-realistic fantasy game asset quality matching existing illustrated statue, readable chunky forms, neither photorealistic monumental architecture nor childish cartoon. Aim achievable modular optimized game art, no ubiquitous extravagant carvings.
Exterior on existing grassy rocky hill plateau with distant subdued snowy mountain, simple uncluttered paving to door; same dark materials clearly visible in overcast daylight, not a black silhouette. Entrance detail is critical: wide level doorway with flat continuous stone paving flowing gently up to interior finished floor, no high lip, no floating slab, no big stairs. Open wooden double doors folded into side recesses. EXACTLY TWO approved Western dragon statues on separate low plinths flanking the doorway OUTSIDE the walking path, both chest and head facing forward out toward approaching visitor/camera, not facing wall, not one looking backward, not fighting each other; mirrored wing/tail silhouettes where helpful. Wide unobstructed central corridor between their bases, no floor lamp, pole, furniture or greenery in passage. TWO small wall mounted lamps outside door at edges, not standing streetlights. Through doorway glimpse aligned burgundy runner on dark stone floor. Show enough paving and door base to judge elevation and statue orientation. No characters, UI, labels all over art, watermarks or extra statues. Strong consistent lighting and matching geometry between two panels.
prompts.interior:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape INTERIOR target concept sheet for the SAME existing Dragon castle. This is a production-conscious refurbishment, not a new room layout. Three coherent detailed views arranged with a large left panel 58% width taking full height for throne hall, right column upper half for west library, right column lower half for east dining room. Discreet elegant Chinese gold headings exactly "大厅 · 清晰中轴", "西翼书库 · 单套陈设", "东翼宴会厅 · 留足通道". Footer exactly "概念方案 · 非游戏实机". All three views show an achievable stylized fantasy 3D game environment, consistent dark charcoal violet stone, navy slate accents, restrained aged gold, deep walnut and burgundy textiles. Hand-painted semi-realistic fantasy game art, readable moderately chunky geometry, not hyperreal gothic cathedral, not toy cartoon, interiors well exposed to judge furniture positions. Warm practical wall lights with subtle soft cool stained-glass accents, not black moody darkness.
References: image 1 is CURRENT actual throne hall screenshot for layout, floor-axis, two existing side stairs, approximate human scale; remove UI and character from concept. Image 2 is the approved detailed throne to REUSE, exactly one in the room. Image 3 is approved detailed bookshelf to REUSE in west library only. Image 4 is newly approved-for-review exterior concept for matching materials and stylization (not for changing room layout).
Hall architecture: approximately 14 m wide and 22 m long, centered south entrance, narrow lateral side aisles, exactly two rows of columns at left and right. West and east lateral rooms attach near the middle. At north end, throne remains on its existing compact low three-step dais, exactly one detailed purple cushioned dragon throne facing entrance. TWO existing straight flights of stairs run along rear left and right walls, rising toward north rear gallery at about 4.2m floor height; they connect across the rear behind throne. Show both stairs/readable access, no new grand sweeping central stair or bifurcated stairs in front of throne, do not move throne. Keep a clear 2.5m central burgundy carpet from entrance to dais. Precisely one armor stand per side inside front column recesses, facing inward toward hall, not standing on carpet or stair access. Two small braziers flank throne steps without impeding route. One pair of suspended iron chandeliers well above path. Existing throne replaces old low-poly throne AND removes obsolete big golden wing-shaped duplicate backdrop. No giant wing planks behind throne, no second throne, no bookshelves in main aisle, no extra freestanding statues in hall, no outside streetlamp. Floor dark worn stone slab checker pattern subtly differing grey-violet values, not stark white. Stone arch depth, softened edges, restrained carved pier capitals; light enough to see details. Camera at doorway aimed toward throne, wider than screenshot to reveal left/right room entrances and rear side stairs without changing footprint.
Library: compact 6m x7m west wing, viewed from its east entrance into west wall. Two approved detailed bookshelf instances flanking one narrow stained-glass window on west wall; each entirely separate with visible space between shelf and window, bookshelf fronts face camera/room. These are the ONLY two tall bookshelves in this concept, no old shelves behind them, no shelf-on-shelf duplication, no overlapping crowns, no wall-to-wall infinitely repeated library. One existing walnut reading table and exactly two chairs at center kept modest, a small existing globe in corner. Clear walkable space around table and to entry, nothing blocks window or opening, no ladder across route, contained small book clusters on table.
Dining room: compact 6m x7m east wing, existing single long wooden banquet table along room length, chairs aligned beside it and not intersecting wall, central burgundy runner and sparse utensils; existing wall fireplace retained on outside wall, clear walking lane from doorway around the table to fireplace, no bookshelf, armor, statue, repeated table, or indoor streetlamp. Keep room proportions modest and consistent with main hall, not gigantic palace.
Constraint: all heavy detail near touch/eye level, reuse same trim/masonry style between rooms, no new rooms, no extra floor levels. Show a tidy intentional functional furnishing scheme, everything rests on floor, no floating furniture, no obstructed doors, no seams through plinths. No diagram arrows or speculative layout reshuffling.

placement_rules: Preserve room footprints, door openings, stair routes, tower arrangement and user scene transforms; generated views illustrate art direction, not measured construction drawings.
Remove castle day/night material recolor; preserve world day/night lighting.
Two entrance dragon statues face approaching visitors, bases outside doorway clearance; validate actual mesh forward axis rather than copying equal Euler rotations.
Replace old west-library shelf geometry embedded in castle_rooms before placing new shelves; two detailed shelves flank existing west window; preserve table, chairs and circulation.
Remove obsolete throne and wing backdrop embedded in old geometry when retaining detailed Tripo throne; preserve dais location and side stairs.
Repair level floor-to-road transition and remove central obstructing lamp; prefer side wall lights.
Avoid old/new overlapping doors, shelves, throne, armor and stone bases; all new finishes need collision and player passage checks.
Concept detail does not establish measured geometry, collision, capacity or final asset costs.
